title: Receive what is given and keep the Naam
summary: What He gives is received; mercy turns it into the Jewel of Naam. Return to Hukam before the self starts arguing again.
takeaway: Return to Hukam before the self starts arguing again.
lifeApplication: Before arguing with the moment again, stop, name what is already here, and let one resistance fall away.

source.shortMeaning: What He gives is received; mercy turns it into the Jewel of Naam.
source.lifeApplication: When the day gives what you did not order, receive it and hold fast to Naam.

evidence.coreClaim: What He gives is received; mercy turns it into the Jewel of Naam.
evidence.turn: Learn to receive under the Lord's pleasure rather than argue with it.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before arguing with the moment again, stop, name what is already here, and let one resistance fall away.
